name: Puzzle Sheets
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Printable puzzles and games, computed entirely in your browser, in every language's own letters (accents fold into the grid the way puzzle books do it): a WORD SEARCH from your own words with hard mode, in a square or a heart, star, letter or the silhouette of your image, optionally with a HIDDEN MESSAGE spelled by the leftover letters; a real CROSSWORD from your word-and-clue pairs with numbered cells and Across/Down lists, and a PICTURE CROSSWORD with emoji clues for children who cannot read yet - both, like the criss-cross, with an optional SOLUTION WORD in numbered cells for a prize draw; a NONOGRAM whose solved picture is a heart, star, letter or the SILHOUETTE OF YOUR IMAGE - printed hint dots guarantee it stays solvable by pure line logic; a real MAZE generated inside shapes including an image silhouette, and a true CIRCLE MAZE of rings and spokes that leads from the middle out; a PHOTO JIGSAW with classic interlocking cut lines (the solution sheet numbers every piece); DOT TO DOT traced from an image silhouette with numbered dots; SUDOKU in several sizes with a guaranteed unique solution, and a PICTURE SUDOKU with emoji instead of numbers; a CRISS-CROSS word grid; BINARY PUZZLES with balanced zero/one rows and columns and no triples; INEQUALITY PUZZLES with unique numbers per row and column and comparison clues, both with a verified unique solution; MATH CHAINS with integer answers and difficulty levels; ARITHMETIC DRILLS for plus, minus, times tables and division in graded number ranges, in rows or written in columns on squared paper, with the blank anywhere if you like; TELLING TIME with clock faces to read or to draw the hands on, from full hours to single minutes; BINGO CARDS - guaranteed-different cards per set, each its own layer; ANAGRAMS with letter tiles and answer boxes; MISSING LETTERS, words with gaps to fill in; MAGIC SQUARES in several number ranges, each with exactly one solution; MEMORY CARDS as a cut-out sheet with a matching duplex back sheet; GAME SHEETS for the categories game, battleships, dots & boxes, hangman, tic-tac-toe and a code breaker; a SECRET CODE cryptogram; an ADDITION PYRAMID solvable by pure logic - and the PUZZLE PACK, which turns one word list into a whole activity set (word search, criss-cross, maze, anagrams, two bingo cards, pyramid) with solutions, every sheet its own layer, in one click. WORKSHEETS: a line for name, class and date, a task in your words, several different sudokus, mazes or logic puzzles on one numbered page with a matching solution page, and SERIES of lettered versions - each its own layer, the solutions sharing one sheet. Word suggestions for seasons, holidays, school, animals, space, sports and more fill the list in your language. Titles use the editor font catalog, colors come from preset palettes, your brand kit or custom colors, and puzzles ship optional SOLUTION SHEETS. Perfect for teachers, birthday parties, wedding favors and company flyers. Insert as editable layers and reopen via Edit Puzzle Sheets.
